results.notes: Main PDF pp. 3 and 5. The deposited data have exactly the reported analyzed study count, with one advice output per writer: 547 treatment and 557 control rows. All deposited rows are used; no further exclusion is applied. Outcome column: num_unique_entities. Means/SDs use the participant-level posted outcome, with SD denominator n-1. Named-entity scores are the deposited scores, not newly generated NLP scores. The difference is treatment minus control in original outcome units. SE is from participant-level OLS with intercept and arm indicator, covariance HC2, independently checked against sqrt(s_treatment^2/n_treatment + s_control^2/n_control). Assignment is individual and between people; round=all and n_clusters=null. The paper reports conventional F tests, which are reproduced separately from the requested robust SE.

Main PDF p. 8: all 1,493 recipient means and repeated-measures F tests reproduce. However, the writer sample cannot be reproduced for the full set of ratings. The method specifies a source pool of 125 texts per arm. The ratings contain 126 AI and 127 Google texts. Formatting-only matching (whitespace and leading spreadsheet apostrophe) uniquely links all 250 deposited S3 writers, but one additional AI text (11 ratings) and two additional Google texts (25 ratings) have no matching S3 writer. There are no writer IDs or exclusion flags resolving these extra texts. They are not assumed to be additional randomized people; discarding them would change the published rating sample. Therefore all computed fields are null. The advice-pool checks count texts, not people. Recipient paired SEs would not be writer-level SEs. No first_round result is appropriate because writers were assigned between people.

Supplement PDF pp. 6-7. SA2_data.csv contains 1,999 rows (975 gpt, 1,024 google), whereas the paper states a final sample of 1,976 and prints F denominators of 1,971. The treatment mean is 2.915897, which rounds to 2.92 rather than the printed 2.91. Although F and p round to the printed values, the means/counts do not jointly reproduce. The available CSV has no attention-check, unrelated-advice, technical-error or analysis-inclusion flags identifying the additional exclusions. No outcome-driven exclusions are inferred and no participant contrast is computed.
